source_title: team-spotube/spotube: 🎧 Open source music streaming app! Available for both desktop & mobile! - GitHub
source_excerpt:
A cross-platform extensible open-source music streaming platform. Bring your own music metadata/playlist/audio-source with plugins created by community or by yourself. A small step towards the decentralized music streaming era!
🧩 Plugin powered, supports any platform or custom music service through plugins.
🗺️ Community driven plugins for popular platforms or create your own.
⬇️ Freely downloadable tracks with tagged metadata .
🕒 Time synced lyrics regardless of the plugin support.
✋ No telemetry, diagnostics or user data collection.
🔉 Playback control is done locally, not on the server.
Download Spotube from the Official Website: https://spotube.cc
Grab the latest nightly builds of Spotube from the Offical Website .

Linux only: runtime libraries, including VLC. Needed to run the app, including :composeApp:run : Distro Command Debian/Ubuntu sudo apt-get install libvlc5 vlc-plugin-base libwebkit2gtk-4.1-0 libgtk-3-0 libasound2 libgl1 libxtst6 libxi6 libxrender1 Fedora sudo dnf install vlc-libs webkit2gtk4.1 gtk3 alsa-lib mesa-libGL libXtst libXi libXrender ( vlc-libs needs RPM Fusion ) Arch / CachyOS / Manjaro sudo pacman -S vlc webkit2gtk-4.1 gtk3 alsa-lib libglvnd libxtst libxi libxrender openSUSE sudo zypper install libvlc5 libwebkit2gtk-4_1-0 libgtk-3-0 libasound2 Mesa-libGL1 libXtst6 libXi6 libXrender1 On Ubuntu 24.04+/Debian 13, libgtk-3-0 and libasound2 are libgtk-3-0t64 and libasound2t64 ; apt resolves this itself.

Use ./gradlew :composeApp:assembleNightlyDebug for the nightly channel.
Development builds stay fast: the release-only optimizations below are skipped.
A native build takes about 10 minutes , uses every CPU core and peaks at ~15 GB of RAM . It only happens for the tasks below, never for run .
Native toolchain (Nucleus downloads GraalVM CE on the first build; set GRAALVM_HOME to use your own):
Output folder: composeApp/build/compose/binaries/main/graalvm-app/
Keep the spotube binary next to the libraries it was built with; it loads them from its own folder.
Installers (each OS builds only its own):
Output folder: composeApp/build/compose/binaries/main/graalvm-
[!Tip] Add -Pnightly=true for the nightly channel (separate icons and name).
DownloadLinuxGtkBundleTask downloads the Ubuntu 24.04 packages (audio-only VLC via vlcj-bundler , GTK 3, WebKitGTK 4.1, glib-networking), keeps only what GTK/WebKit reach and relocates the libraries with patchelf . Needs ar , tar , zstd , readelf , patchelf .
WebKitGTK has its helper-process path compiled in, so AppImageEnvironment patches it to a relative path and moves to that directory at startup. It also sets GIO_EXTRA_MODULES and WEBKIT_DISABLE_DMABUF_RENDERER=1 (the bundled WebKitGTK 2.44 never paints against a newer host Mesa).
main() must call GraalVmInitializer.initialize() first: the VLC loader and the environment setup read compose.application.resources.dir .
A native image is a closed world: everything reached through reflection, JNI or JNA (vlcj, Zipline, NewPipe, ktor, datastore, ...) must be declared at build time. Nucleus generates most of it; the rest lives in composeApp/graalvm/reachability-metadata.json .
Symptoms: ClassNotFoundException , NoSuchMethodException or MissingReflectionRegistrationError in the native binary, while :composeApp:run works.
./gradlew :composeApp:runWithNativeAgent starts the app on the JVM with GraalVM's tracing agent.
Use the broken feature, then close the window normally . Ctrl+C discards the recording.
Commit the updated JSON in composeApp/graalvm/ and rebuild.
[!Tip] ./gradlew :composeApp:runGraalvmNative is a faster debug loop: a quick -Ob build that names the missing registration.
[!Warning] Keep the hand-written uk.co.caprica.vlcj.binding.lib.LibVlc entry, or playback fails to initialize.
Production mode turns on automatically for package* , create* , notarize* and nativeImageCompile tasks. Force it with -Pproduction=true|false .
Android picks the Rust profile from its build type.
Run spotube-release-binary.yml manually ( workflow_dispatch ) as stable , beta or nightly .
Beta: the stable build as a draft, tagged v -beta.N . Set betaNumber in composeApp/build.gradle.kts to N, and back to null for stable.
Desktop: each platform (Linux x86_64 and aarch64, Windows, macOS) builds its installers on its own runner.
